description: EdgeContainerDeployer::secrets() merges EdgeMeter::env($site) (DPLY_METER_KEY) into the container's env, where app code (and soon the Console) can read it and sign forged usage reports. Keep it in the Worker, which does the metering. From r-5w7h5d0b902aeq0n Q6.
title: Move the AI meter key out of the container env
